senses.gloss:
हुम् Ind.
 1. An interjection of remembering, (ha, ah!)
 2. Of repulse
or reproach, (away!)
 3. Interrogation, (hey?)
 4. Assent, (yes.)
5. Doubt.
 6. A mystical syllable of frequent occurrence in incan-
tations.
 E. हु to sacrifice, डुमि or डुम् aff.: see हूम् ।

हूम् Ind.
 1. A particle of doubt or consideration (humph, ha.)
 2. An
interrogatory particle, (hey, indeed.)
 3. A particle of assent, (yes,
[]
well, so be it, amen.)
 4. An interjection of anger.
 5. Of fear.
6. Of reproach, or contempt, (equivalent to be silent, tush,
pish.)
 7. Of aversion, repulse, or dislike, &c.
 8. A magical
or mystical monosyllable.
 9. An imitative sound.
 E. ह्वेञ् to call,
aff. डूमि or डूम्ः see हुम्.
